metadata.llm_reason: Candidate is a Spring Framework 6.0/Boot 3.0 URL trailing slash routing configuration skill with distinct semantic identity (web_routing, configuration_adjustment, post_upgrade_validation). It does not match any existing skills in the registry, which contain Flink streaming setup and UI link prefetching—entirely different domains and task families. Peer candidates are also distinct Spring Boot 3.0 migration skills (security, properties, build config) that do not overlap with URL routing behavior. The candidate is well-supported by Spring Boot 3.0 Migration Guide evidence and addresses a real breaking change in Spring 6.0.
